messages:
emma-partnerops: Heads-up  Quick proposal for marketplace + hardware-bundle routing to avoid duplicate outreach.
raj-sales-eu: Good timing. we lost time last week to a cross-reach with infraSI.
sophia-si-manager: simple rule: if deal uses certified SI SKU OR SI is on the marketplace listing -> SI gets primary ownership and 24h ack SLA.
mike-revops: i can add `co_sell_path` and `si_certified` fields in SFDC and a workflow.
lina-ps: add a 7-day quiet period after SI intro unless SI opts into joint outreach. that protects partner relationships.
emma-partnerops: agree. add a small decision matrix doc and a one-line intro email template.
ops-bot: automation: when co_sell_path==marketplace_certified AND si_certified==true -> create task "SI Acknowledge Intro" assign si_owner.
raj-sales-eu: override flow? we still need a manager override for strategic small accounts.
sophia-si-manager: manager override: AE files `co_sell_override`, partnerops reviews within 36h, default to redwood-led if no decision.
lina-ps: i'll put the email template and matrix in the sales playbook and run a 20-min training tomorrow.
emma-partnerops: action items: mike adds fields+workflow (ETA 24h), sophia publishes cert roster (EOD), lina runs training (tomorrow). vp-partnerships: thanks team  this should cut friction. post any partner pushback here.
